description_en: Creates web filtering rules in batches under a specified web filtering template. A maximum of 100 rules can be created at a time, and the total number of rules in the template after creation must not exceed 100
description_zh: 在指定Web过滤模板下批量创建Web过滤规则。单次最多创建100条规则，且创建后模板内规则总数不超过100条
name: CreateWebFilterRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the web filtering template to which the web filtering rules belong. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤规则所属的Web过滤模板ID。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板
parameters.name: web_filter_template_id

fields.help_en: The type of the matching condition. Only URL is supported, which indicates matching by URL
fields.help_zh: 匹配条件的类型。取值仅支持URL，表示按URL匹配
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The URL to match. It cannot be empty and must not exceed 240 bytes in length (each Chinese character counts as 3 bytes). It must contain at least one forward slash (/), and the first segment must contain letters, digits, or Chinese characters. It cannot contain a protocol header, query parameters, or fragment identifiers. A single asterisk () indicates matching all URLs. When a wildcard is used, a maximum of one wildcard is allowed and it must end with /. URLs within the same template cannot be duplicated
fields.help_zh: 匹配的URL。不能为空，长度不超过240个字节（中文按3个字节计算）。必须包含至少一个正斜线（/），首个分段需包含字母、数字或中文；不能携带协议头、查询参数或片段标识。单独传入星号（）表示匹配全部URL；使用通配符时最多1个且必须以/结尾。同一模板内URL不可重复
fields.name: values

fields.help_en: The list of matching conditions for the rule. The list must contain exactly one condition
fields.help_zh: 规则的匹配条件列表。必须且只能包含1个条件
fields.name: conditions

fields.help_en:
The action to perform when a rule is matched. Valid values:
Allow: allows the request.
Alert: monitors the request.
Deny: blocks the request
fields.help_zh:
规则命中后执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
fields.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en: The list of web filtering rules. You can specify a maximum of 100 rules at a time, and the total number of rules in the template after creation must not exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤规则列表。单次最多传入100条规则，且创建后模板内规则总数不超过100条
parameters.name: rules

WebFilterRuleIds.description_en: The list of IDs of the newly created web filtering rules. The order of the IDs corresponds one-to-one with the order of the input Rules parameter
WebFilterRuleIds.description_zh: 新建的Web过滤规则ID列表，与入参Rules的顺序一一对应

items.description_en: The ID of the web filtering rule
